info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_E-Commerce Card Payment Gateway API
info.description: The E-Commerce Card Payment Gateway API enables seamless online transactions for businesses by providing access to secure payment processing services. This endpoint allows for the retrieval of transaction details and payment status information related to card payments made through the e-commerce platform. Ideal for developers and businesses that require efficient, reliable access to payment data, this API supports various use cases, including payment reconciliation and customer transaction history review. Ensure smooth operational efficiency and enhance the customer experience with this vital banking service.

get.summary: Retrieve e-commerce payment details via card.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of card-based e-commerce payments. You can query specific transactions and view their status, amount, and other relevant information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a card e-commerce payment operation. It contains the necessary details that will facilitate the processing of a payment through an e-commerce gateway.

200.description: Request completed successfully and returned the payment gateway details.

GetCardEcommerceGatewayPaymentsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to card e-commerce gateway payments.

GetCardEcommerceGatewayPaymentsResponse_.title: E-commerce Gateway Payment Response

items.description: An array of payment objects representing individual payment transactions.

sort.description: Sorting criteria applied to the response.

GetCardEcommerceGatewayPaymentsResponse_.description: This schema represents the response structure for the e-commerce gateway payment operations. It contains a list of payment items, pagination details, sorting information, and metadata about the response.
